rationale: D. piger oxidizes lactate coupled to sulfate reduction as primary metabolism. Lactate (10 mmol/gDW/h) and amino acid uptake (2.3 mmol N/gDW/h) support growth limited by nitrogen availability at 0.35 /h. Carbon balance: 30 mmol C input minus 15 mmol C biomass leaves 15 mmol C for fermentation products (CO₂, H₂S, acetate). Sulfate reduction is energetically favorable in anaerobic conditions.
